stem:
A random variable $X$ has probability density function given by

$$\text{f}(x) = \begin{cases} k(2x^2 - x^3) & 0 \leqslant x \leqslant 2, \\ 0 & \text{otherwise.} \end{cases}$$

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: The median of $X$ is denoted by $m$.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Write down the value of $\text{P}(X \leqslant m)$.
